blocks.md: If the red mug rides past on the far side of the belt, beyond the arm's physical reach from where the base is parked, no sequence of joint torques can bring the gripper to its handle. In an embodied ML system, this physical impossibility must be intercepted at the proposal boundary, before the target enters the trajectory optimization queue.
